type NameErr = Unsafe(name: str)

def resolve_name(name: str) -> str | None:
    """Return name unchanged when it is a plain file name with no path parts, or None otherwise."""
    ex resolve_name("notes.txt") == "notes.txt"
    ex resolve_name("../secret.txt") is None
    ex resolve_name("/etc/passwd") is None
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return None
    if "/" in name or "\\" in name or ":" in name:
        return None
    return name.copy()

def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str uses fs:
    """Return the text of the first name in names that can be read from the notes directory, or "" if none can.

    Names are untrusted. Each name is checked with resolve_name and must be a plain file name.
    Only files inside notes are read, confined with fs.sub("notes"). A name that is unsafe,
    missing, or unreadable is skipped.
    """
    pre names.len() < 10000
    post out.byte_len() >= 0
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        for name in names:
            safe = resolve_name(name)
            if safe is not None:
                text = fs.read(safe) else ""
                if text.byte_len() > 0:
                    return text
    return ""
